description: Pinned data vintage for calendar-independent reproduction. When SEED is set, data.download() will use this end date instead of datetime.utcnow(), ensuring the same cache keys are used regardless of when the script is run.
note: This manifest records the UTC end-date of the committed parquet cache in data/. The archive was created on 2026-10-13 with data through 2026-10-12. Override with END_DATE environment variable if needed.
